instances.query:
I am playing with a set of tegusts where I need to arrange the tegusts into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a tegust
Unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust
Put down a tegust
Stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one tegust at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a tegust if my michime is winnilic.
I can only pick up a tegust if the tegust is roperung atop the facizer and the tegust is nostactible. A tegust is nostactible if the tegust has no other tegusts roperung atop it and if the tegust is not picked up.
I can only unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking was really roperung atop the other tegust.
I can only unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking is nostactible.
Once I pick up or unstack a tegust, I am jillerating the tegust.
I can only put down a tegust that I am jillerating.
I can only stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust if I am jillerating the tegust being stacked.
I can only stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust if the tegust onto which I am stacking the tegust is nostactible.
Once I put down or stack a tegust, my michime becomes winnilic.
Once you stack a tegust roperung atop a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer nostactible.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the michime is winnilic, the blue tegust is nostactible, the blue tegust is roperung atop the orange tegust, the orange tegust is roperung atop the yellow tegust, the yellow tegust is roperung atop the red tegust and the red tegust is roperung atop the facizer.
My goal is to have that the blue tegust is roperung atop the red tegust.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
instances.ground_truth_plan:
(unstack b2 b3)
(put-down b2)
(unstack b3 b4)
(put-down b3)
(unstack b4 b1)
(put-down b4)
(pick-up b2)
(stack b2 b1)

Unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust
Put down a tegust
Stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one tegust at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a tegust if my michime is winnilic.
I can only pick up a tegust if the tegust is roperung atop the facizer and the tegust is nostactible. A tegust is nostactible if the tegust has no other tegusts roperung atop it and if the tegust is not picked up.
I can only unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking was really roperung atop the other tegust.
I can only unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking is nostactible.
Once I pick up or unstack a tegust, I am jillerating the tegust.
I can only put down a tegust that I am jillerating.
I can only stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust if I am jillerating the tegust being stacked.
I can only stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust if the tegust onto which I am stacking the tegust is nostactible.
Once I put down or stack a tegust, my michime becomes winnilic.
Once you stack a tegust roperung atop a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer nostactible.
